testcase.name: Scenario: Float and redock the model browser: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:779:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Float and redock the model browser ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is open in the MCAD Software with the model browser docked on the left ✔ And the browser tree and shaded block are visible ✔ When the user drags the Model tab into the viewport and release it ✔ Then the browser becomes a floating panel over the viewport ✔ And the browser tree remains available in the floating panel ✔ And the viewport occupies the space formerly used by the docked panel ✔ When the user drags the floating Model tab to the left edge and release it ✔ Then the browser docks on the left again ✔ And the tree and shaded block remain visible
